pedidos.titulo: Photos of a house for sale

tomas.desc: Hold still in front of the house, showing the facade and the sign.
Go around one side of the house without losing it from the center.
Start low and close, then rise while pulling away: the whole house comes into view.

entrenar.nota: E6 · Video on a path, with your drone and no wind.

pedidos.historia: Doña Marta is selling her mother's house and can't afford a photographer. You've got a wooden drone and plenty of drive.
Don Ernesto saw the house video and wants one of his farm to sell milk to a supermarket. Up there the wind always blows.

entrenar.nota: E8 · Video in the wind (2.5 m/s). Without wind in training, the AI can't compensate for gusts.

tomas.desc: From the barn door, rise while pulling away until the whole farm is in view.
A big, high loop around the barn (with the silo behind it).
Hold still, high up, with the barn in the center and the silo beside it.

pedidos.titulo: La Brasa restaurant for social media
pedidos.historia: You have a shop now and clients who pay for real. Doña Lucía wants a video for Instagram, but there are people eating on the terrace and poles on the sidewalk.

entrenar.nota: E9 · Between poles, with your drone. For the AI to see the poles, give it the ToF sensors.

tomas.desc: Hold still in front of the restaurant, at the height of the sign.
Half a loop along the sidewalk, passing between the poles and the wall.
From the sidewalk, rise while pulling away over the street.

pedidos.titulo: A new car at the dealership
pedidos.historia: Low, fast shots around a shiny car: any vibration shows.
The first subject that moves: a cyclist at 6 m/s along the road.
A ball that keeps changing direction, high shots and wind.
Multi-camera: you and two AI drones, each with its own angle.
Follow someone walking between tree trunks, flying low.
At night, in strong wind, with three AI drones.
The finale: a chase filmed by four autonomous drones.

capitulos.historia: You have $150, an ESP32 and some motors you pulled out of a toy drone. Build something that flies, land your first client and learn to film for real.
People know you now. Clients show up with people nearby, obstacles and quality demands: time for serious parts (STM32, ExpressLRS, PETG).
Now things move: cyclists, matches. Gimbal, GPS and lots of speed. Your AI has to learn to follow.
One drone isn't enough anymore: you fly one and your AI drones film from other angles.
They call you to film a movie: a chase with four autonomous drones. Everything you've learned, all together.

final: You did it! From a wooden drone to an aerial film studio. Garaje Films is now called Aerial Studio. Thanks for playing: free mode is unlocked.
